scope: Four front reference masters and identical crop/front copies. Celine 1 is the exact user-approved comparison winner; other three are one original-photo edit each. Other views unchanged.

prompts.prompt:
Photo 1 is the original studio photograph to edit. Photo 2 supplies only Vision's facial identity and golden blonde hair.
Replace the woman’s face and hair in photo 1 with Vision’s recognizable face and hair, adapted to photo 1’s head angle and neutral expression. Keep the original head size and natural neck length. Match the soft photographic skin finish, lighting and skin color of photo 1; do not copy exaggerated skin texture from photo 2. No added pores, stippling, flaky texture, grain or sharpening. Keep the eyes and lips naturally in focus, with gentle skin tones and no blurry face or plastic sheen.
Preserve photo 1’s exact body, pose, hands, jewelry, pink and yellow striped shirt and shorts, garment folds, background, shadows and full original framing. The only other edit is removing the small “22” tattoo from the upper arm. Do not restyle the clothes, invent details or add text. Return one seamless photograph.
